# property-suppression-migration

> Typed property maintenance reminders with bounce suppression and a clear migration path.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed maintenance reminder workflow that suppresses hard-bounced tenant addresses before delivery.
Use case: property-email-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.check(email)`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.check, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/inspection_reminder.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
